wrap_habitat_env_in_gym: wrap a Habitat RLEnv with HabGymWrapper to expose a standard OpenAI Gym interface
create_action_space_from_habitat: create a gym Box or Discrete action space from a Habitat task action space using create_action_space
convert_continuous_action_to_habitat_dic: convert a numpy array continuous action vector into a Habitat-compatible action dictionary
filter_observation_space_by_keys: filter a Habitat observation space to include only specified keys using filter_observation_space
render_habitat_env_as_rgb_array: render the wrapped Habitat environment as an RGB array or human display using HabGymWrapper render
